event_contact_audience_0da9f54adbced7a4d.basis_goal: Receiving access for player contact request wei-seek-qin-military-receiving-office-r44-20260815

delivery.route: Qin Military Bureau receiving office in Kanyou

event_contact_audience_0da9f54adbced7a4d.summary: The Qin Military Bureau receiving office makes a duty officer available to hear Tang Wei regarding the northern Wei operation. This establishes a hearing only: Tang Wei has not yet made a substantive request, and Qin has made no appointment, command, deployment decision, or commitment.

event_family_counsel_response_14f8deacee.basis_goal: Tang Ling responds to Tang Wei's request for counsel
event_family_counsel_response_14f8deacee.summary: Tang Ling advises separating preparation from commitment: verify which Qin authority owns the matter and what formal request, if any, actually reaches House Tang before spending new House silver or binding House forces. In the meantime she recommends preserving the House's existing obligations and gathering firmer political and logistical information rather than treating preparations as a settled campaign result.

event_family_counsel_response_d5988c969b.basis_goal: Tang Zhu responds to Tang Wei's request for counsel
event_family_counsel_response_d5988c969b.summary: Tang Zhu advises preparing without pretending preparation is deployment: keep House military readiness in hand, clarify command, route, supply, timing, and the strength Qin actually requires, and do not march House forces into a state campaign merely because reports say an operation is forming. He recommends acting once a lawful command or a deliberate House decision gives the effort a concrete objective.

event_house_recruitment_report_b27d8be50.summary: House Tang reports that Great Bow Guard applicant intake is open under the recorded treasury-safe ceiling. The intake opened at 245-BCE-12-07T11:05:48+08:00; no fighter headcount is implied by the opening itself.

event_house_recruitment_report_e7535ba6a.summary: House Tang reports that Great Bow Guard recruitment has registered 1200 real applicants in the candidate ledger. No one has yet passed screening: 0 screened, 0 rejected, and 0 accepted fighters. Candidate contact has cost 120 silver so far; later screening, training, equipment, and acceptance remain separate conserved consequences.

event_household_response_221646fe94f55f0.basis_goal: House Tang response to player request wei-order-sword-manor-expansion-training-promotion-r98-20260816
event_household_response_221646fe94f55f0.summary: Tang Ling and Tang Zhu start the first Sword Manor expansion tranche for 1800000 silver. They immediately raise the authorized trainee establishment by 1000 places, allowing 500 new Initiates to be admitted now from conserved Qin population using existing spare housing. Construction is due to complete at 244-BCE-02-23T20:22:48+08:00; when complete it will add 2000 trainee housing places, 1000 further authorized trainee places, and 250 monthly intake capacity. The ordinary Sword Manor training and promotion ladder remains in force and now runs on its intended monthly causal review; standards are unchanged.

event_household_response_3f508f5bd74dc99.basis_goal: House Tang response to player request wei-ask-house-investigate-northern-wei-and-recruitment-costs-r74-20260816
event_household_response_3f508f5bd74dc99.summary: Tang Ling completes the House review requested from the delivered northern-operation report. The military information available to this House review remains the report already received: Reports reaching Tang Wei through merchants, court reports, military dispatches, price and troop movement concern major Qin operation against northern Wei while Qin court power is divided. The latest report describes material domain work that actually settled. House accounts place the current discretionary treasury-safe ceiling at 4370400 silver after protecting 10536000 silver of stable expense reserve. Great Bow Guard applicant intake is open. The current House program record establishes 0 accepted fighters and 0 silver committed by the opening itself; it does not yet register separate applicant, screened, or rejected totals, so those figures cannot be claimed from the records. Sword Manor has no current trainee vacancy; its next normal review is not presently scheduled. This review establishes planning information only; it creates no Qin appointment or deployment order and does not claim enemy dispositions beyond the delivered report.

event_household_response_769c2d0b8dd70ce.basis_goal: House Tang response to player request wei-request-gbg-and-sword-manor-initiates-r28-20260815
event_household_response_769c2d0b8dd70ce.summary: House Tang opens Great Bow Guard applicant intake under a treasury-safe ceiling of 4370400 silver. Opening the intake creates no fighter headcount and commits no spending; standards remain unchanged. event_household_response_fe299524f7735dc.basis_goal: House Tang response to player request wei-ask-zhu-parallel-recruitment-constraints-r30-20260815
event_household_response_fe299524f7735dc.summary: Tang Zhu identifies the current practical constraints on parallel recruiting: Great Bow Guard remains an applicant intake only; screening, accepted headcount, equipment and formation creation have not yet settled; Sword Manor has no trainee vacancy. The two programs remain institutionally separate, so one does not consume the other's authorized fighting establishment.
